# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 reg-serbia phases 1-4, Serbia and the Danube Line (1371-1460). Generated by gen_serbia_danube.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Location scope. Hand this place to $to$ (an AI country: every caller checks the giver holds it in hand and that both
# countries are AI and outside the empire's side) and settle it on its new owner (decision 296; vanilla's peaceful
# handovers: rise_of_the_ottomans.txt:707-708, flavor_TUR.txt:17597-17599, red_turban_rebellions.txt:257-258,
# flavor_decisions_byz.txt:117). No core. Used by W9, W11, W11b, W12, W14, W15, W16 (gen_serbia_danube.py).
oe_smd_hand = {
    change_location_owner = $to$ change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
}

# Any scope. $by$ annexes $who$ in peace (both AI: the caller checks) and the annexed places are settled on $by$
# (decision 296-1, the form batch15b gives W5 and W8: mark the annexed country's places with oe_smd_settle, annex, settle
# and unmark the annexer's marked places, back to core integration where they are its cores; clear the marks an
# annexation refused left standing). No core is added. Used by W11 and W16.
oe_smd_annex = {
    $who$ = { every_owned_location = { set_variable = oe_smd_settle } }
    $by$ = { annex_country = { country = $who$ reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    $by$ = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } if = { limit = { is_core_of = $by$ } change_integration_level = core } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = $who$ } $who$ = { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_smd_settle } remove_variable = oe_smd_settle } } }
}
